dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: So you're back, what do you think? Yi'nian makes some mean grub, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He said he wouldn't look at the document...

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Oh yeah? ...He said that last year, too... If he'd listened to our marketing tips, he'd be doing even better by now.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Anyway, not to worry. Here's the gift I was talking about. This Xiao Lantern is for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! Such a beautiful lantern! How is it made?

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Uh... I'm afraid I wouldn't be able to explain the process concisely.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: But if you're interested in Xiao Lanterns, you can ask <color=#00E1FFFF>Jingming</color> over there. He's in charge of both the Xiao and Mingxiao Lanterns.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So he's responsible for the super-duper huge one too?

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: That's right! He should be easy to find. Just over there, I think.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If we could make a Xiao Lantern for Xiao... maybe that would cheer him up a bit!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's find <color=#00E1FFFF>Jingming</color> and see what he has to say.
